title: minimax_pos
body_html:
minimax_pos

Lean type

lean theorem minimax_pos (A : I → J → 𝕜) (hA : ∀ i j, 0 < A i j) : ∃ (x : I → 𝕜) (y : J → 𝕜) (v : 𝕜), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) ∧ (∑ i, x i = 1) ∧ (∀ j, 0 ≤ y j) ∧ (∑ j, y j = 1) ∧ (∀ j, v ≤ ∑ i, x i * A i j) ∧ (∀ i, ∑ j, A i j * y j ≤ v)
